openItems.item: The contract defines no maintenance or non-0.24 release path; every surface is blocked until #1408 records MILESTONE-SUCCEEDED. A maintenance path needs a #1407 amendment first.

The release PR precedes #1423 and cannot consume an adjudication identity. Whether checking its products (version, rendered notes) against the record satisfies §8 condition 7, or the row needs an amendment, is undecided.

The release gate compares rebuilt bytes with C2-recorded hashes and fails closed where a build is not byte-reproducible. #1526 makes both NuGet packages, the release metadata, and the website byte-reproducible, and #1527 makes the B2 headline depend only on the candidate. Residuals recorded by #1526: rebuilds must use the same .NET SDK build (a source-built SDK 10.0.401 packs different bytes), and the site downloads Google Fonts at build time. C2 regeneration 3 must show that rebuilt bytes equal its recorded hashes.

Recommended settings not enforceable by a workflow: environment-scoped NUGET_API_KEY with a main-only policy; branch protection without admin bypass and with tests (verification) required; a v* tag ruleset; github-pages deployments restricted to main; a red release-audit run treated as a gate bypass.

G3 is not closed on the candidate. Executions 1-3 establish nothing for it: execution 1 was NON-DETERMINISTIC, execution 2 ran on d42d0313 before the S2 repairs, and execution 3 (c2-1424-regen-2 on 5e52d8ab) was NON-DETERMINISTIC through one harness-cut attempt. C2 regeneration 3 runs protocol 1.5.0 on this candidate: the fourth and last execution, allowed only on this merge commit (budget.extraExecution), within the 3,200 determinism-compute ceiling (contract 1.5.0). A further failure is MILESTONE-FAILED.

supersedes.reason: C2 regeneration 2 (PR #1535, open and unmerged) on 5e52d8ab passed every row except the determinism protocol. Its execution (run 37826943308) was NON-DETERMINISTIC (660 AGREE-PASS, 470 DISAGREE, 1,174 INCOMPLETE; 149 completed attempts and 1 invalid) only because the harness's own 75-minute job deadline cut the 15th attempt of win-x64 job 1, a slow runner, and the 1.4.0 decider compared that attempt's filled-in Timeout values; no two observed values differed. The candidate's frozen protocol refused a fourth execution, so the row would stay BLOCKED. Contract and protocol amendment 1.5.0 (#1537) fixed the rule, gave Windows jobs 110 minutes, and allowed one more execution on the new candidate, which changes the candidate.
supersedes.consequence: Stopping rule 4: every result of C2 regeneration 2 is invalid for the new candidate. Its records stay in PR #1535 as history if it merges, and its determinism result stays reported as decided (NON-DETERMINISTIC). C2 runs regeneration 3, the last one allowed (contract 1.5.0 exception for #1424). A further failure is MILESTONE-FAILED. The 5e52d8ab manifest stays in git at the C1 PR 2 landing.
